meta.homeTitle: Vintage Photo Booth for Events in Israel | Beetle Booth
meta.homeDescription: A real vintage Beetle turned photo booth, at your event anywhere in Israel: instant magnets, selfie booth, glass prints and an audio guestbook.

hero.title: Not just another photo booth
hero.sub: A real vintage Beetle that drives to your event, opens its doors and becomes the spot everyone wants a picture in.
hero.alt: Cream vintage Beetle with a glowing interior at a sunset wedding among palm trees

manifesto.title: You bring the people. We take care of the rest.
manifesto.text: We arrive, open up, set up, and before long the Beetle is part of the party. Guests climb in, laugh, pose and walk away with a printed photo in hand. And you? You just enjoy your event.
manifesto.abroad: Planning an event in Israel from abroad? We sort everything out over WhatsApp, in English.

items.name: Magnets
items.text: Every photo is printed on the spot, in a design we create for your event with your names and date. Guests take it home and it lives on the fridge for years.
items.alt: Printed photo strips with white bows, held in a hand

items.name: Selfie Booth
items.text: A retro wooden booth with a ring light. Step up, smile, and the print is already coming out. Easy for grandma, easy for the kids.
items.alt: Wooden selfie booth with a ring light and screen at an event

items.name: Glass Prints
items.text: The best shot of the night, printed on glass. A premium keepsake for the hosts that won't get lost in an album.

items.name: Audio Memories
items.text: Pick up the receiver and leave a message. At the end of the night you get every recording: the laughs, the tears and the things nobody would ever write in a guestbook.

decor.title: Built into the décor, a booth becomes an attraction
decor.text: Most people book a photo booth and tuck it in a corner. We do it differently: we place the Beetle by the entrance or in front of the view, match it to your event's concept and design the keepsakes in the same style. So it's not a service on the side. It's part of the story.

story.title: How it all started
paragraphs: A little vintage, a lot of character, and two people who went slightly overboard with their dream.

Our Beetle didn't always look like this. Before the magic it was rusty, with peeling paint and a tired steering wheel. We took it apart, sanded it down, reupholstered it in cream leather, added warm lighting and built a photo booth inside. Behind every small detail is Adir, who built it all with his own hands.
And behind the Beetle is a married couple, a little crazy, who simply love what they do. For us it's never just another booking. It's the moment someone climbs in, looks around and says: wow.

items.q: How much space do you need?
items.a: The Beetle needs a flat surface and vehicle access, roughly a parking space with a bit of room around it. The selfie booth needs about two by two metres. We'll check the venue with you beforehand.
Yes, a standard socket close to where we'll stand. If there isn't one, let us know and we'll find a solution.
We arrive before your guests and are ready before the event starts. You don't need to do anything.
We come to events across Israel. Travel costs depend on distance and are spelled out in your quote.
Absolutely. We've done beaches, gardens and halls. Outdoors we need stable ground, and if rain is forecast we'll plan a covered spot.

items.q: How far ahead should we book?
items.a: As early as you can. In wedding season dates go months in advance. Check the calendar to see if yours is still free.
